description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different sentiment analysis tools – TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT – across two categories of tweets: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets”. The horizontal axis represents the tweet categories, labeled “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet”, and is categorical with no defined order. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For the “Emoji Tweets” category, the TEXTBLOB tool is represented by a bar with a diagonal hatch pattern and an approximate height of 0.43, VADER is represented by a solid green bar with a height of approximately 0.65, and ChatGPT is represented by a solid green bar with a height of approximately 0.55. For the “Overall Tweet” category, TEXTBLOB is represented by a bar with a diagonal hatch pattern and a height of approximately 0.45, VADER is represented by a solid green bar with a height of approximately 0.68, and ChatGPT is represented by a solid green bar with a height of approximately 0.62. The bars are grouped by category, with each tool represented by a distinct bar within each category. No bars are visually emphasized, and a legend clarifies the color and pattern associated with each tool.
